title: Orthogonality of irreducible finite-group characters over an algebraically closed field
statement:
Let $F$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and $G$ a finite group. A representation is a finite-dimensional $F$-vector space with an action $\rho:G\to\operatorname{GL}_F(V)$; it is irreducible if it is nonzero and has no nonzero proper invariant subspace. Define its character by $\chi_V(g)=\operatorname{tr}_F(\rho(g))$. For irreducible representations $V,W$ one has
$$|G|^{-1}\sum_{g\in G}\chi_V(g)\chi_W(g^{-1})=\begin{cases}1,&V\simeq W,\\0,&V\not\simeq W.\end{cases}$$
